request.style: English, Celtic folk, weathered warm male vocal, uilleann pipes, fiddle, Celtic harp, bouzouki, bodhran, open and journeying, 88 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
An old man in Haran with his flocks and with his kin
Heard a voice that called him out to where he'd never been
Leave your land, your kindred, and your father's house
And go to the land I will show you
So Abram went, as the LORD had told him
With Sarai by his side and the long road in his eyes

[Verse]
The years went by in Canaan and the cradle still stood bare
Lord GOD, what will you give me
I remain childless
He brought him outside
And told the childless man to lift his weary eyes

[Chorus]
Look up at the sky and count the stars
If you can count them
So shall your offspring be
Abram believed the LORD
And he credited it to him as righteousness

[Bridge]
Up the mountain walked a father with the son he loved
Here are the fire and the wood
But where is the lamb
God himself will provide the lamb
And the two of them walked on together

[Chorus]
Look up at the sky and count the stars
If you can count them
So shall your offspring be
Abram believed the LORD
And he credited it to him as righteousness

[Outro]
Count the stars
If you can count them
So shall your offspring be
